svg.title: SafeRelay — 1ST PLACE / ALAMEDA HACKS
svg.desc: Carry an SOS packet through nearby phones when the towers are gone. BLE store-and-forward with hop limits, expiry and idempotent upload the moment any relay gets online. Built with JAC, SWIFT, CAPACITOR, CORE BLUETOOTH.
